questions.subject: INTEGRATED_3
questions.topic: What an analysis of variance tests
questions.stem: Explaining to a classmate, what does ANOVA test?

answer.exemplar: ANOVA tests whether the means of several groups are all equal, using variance to detect differences among group averages.

questions.explanation: For a what an analysis of variance tests question like this, the governing rule is: Compares group means. Applying it gives "ANOVA tests whether the means of several groups are all equal, using variance to detect differences among group averages" as the answer.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED_3
questions.topic: Slope of a line of best fit
questions.stem: In a standardized integrated mathematics III assessment, explaining to a classmate, slope units are?

options.text: Units of Y per unit of X
Units of X per unit of Y
options.misconception: confuses "Units of X per unit of Y" with the correct "Units of Y per unit of X"

questions.explanation: The rule that settles this slope of a line of best fit item is: Y per X. That is why "Units of Y per unit of X" is right. The option "No units" (slope carries units) does not satisfy the rule.

questions.topic: Predictions from a line of best fit
questions.stem: Explaining to a classmate, line Y=4+1.5X; predict Y at X=2.
questions.explanation: Y=4+1.5*2=7. The rule substitute X gives the value. A quick check with the given numbers returns the same value.
